title: Suction cup unit for gripping workpieces

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.quote: A suction cup unit for gripping workpieces comprises a suction cup member carried by a support body within which a device is arranged for autonomously generating a vacuum to be applied to the suction cup member.
features.note: The reference describes a suction cup unit with a support body (housing) that carries a vacuum generating device, and the unit is for gripping workpieces.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: The reference describes a support body/casing but does not explicitly state that a grip portion is a hollow body or describe a specific grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping device or a grip portion.
